body: ADR 0002 CHECKPOINT 1 is in the working tree: docs/adr/0002-visualization-contract.md (uncommitted; you own pushing). Contents: D1–D7 verbatim from your 'decisions ready for rev 1'; D8 reference seam = core Address protocol + per-module typed refs with Addressable instances + closed ViewRef coproduct assembled in view, with the acyclicity proof from the build.sbt graph (only X->core and view->X edges; codec re-types at the view boundary; note codec/laws do not depend on document today); D9 five typed uncertainty states; D10 recall vocabulary from AlignState; D11 feature colour by FeatureTarget/FeatureDerivation, no alpha-stacking, recipe selector; D12 textual twin; D13 determinism; D14 module placement (view: portable, depends on all domain modules, not codec/DOM/Intaglio; codec gains dependsOn(view); storyatlas4s sibling later). §3 normative type shapes (CommonViewState, TextAnnotation with a single target Address and no parallel claim/evidence fields, CodexFlow with runs tiling canonicalText, ProjectionContract, NarrativeScene, ZoomLevel as two axes). §4 the D4 no-inference table (Loom per-context poset layout, first-span anchoring, ProjectionMode-gated underlines, boundary styles, context bands, reader-horizon closure, no population map). §5 laws V-P/I/E/T/L/U/D/R with ids. §6 six-operation renderer protocol + Intaglio promotion candidates. §7 libraries. §8 your ten-item slice 1 verbatim, tracer, codec milestone with laws. §9 six explicit checkpoints incl. the concrete AddressKey grammar. You may preflight view/** and begin bd-01M14K858TQQH2A46GZBE479YR; please implement against §3–§4 shapes and flag any place they fight the existing types rather than bending them silently. I proceed to proposal rev 1 deltas and the reference-seam bead design; I will not touch view/**.
